metadata.case_name: NG KA CHUK v. WELCOME CONSTRUCTION CO LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: driver and worker (employed by the 2nd Defendant)

injuries.description: fracture of distal fibula Weber Type B
source: Radiological examination revealed fracture of distal fibula Weber Type B.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: tenderness, swelling and bruising around the lateral malleolus of his left ankle
left ankle joint movement was limited by pain
active range of motion of left ankle dorsiflexion, plantar flexion and eversion were full but only 2/3 range for inversion
could walk unaided but with a limping gait and with mild pain
pain on full weight bearing (could squat but suffered pain on full weight bearing)
assessed 2% impairment of the whole person

treatments_received: attendance at A & E Department of Tuen Mun Hospital
admission to the Department of Orthopaedics and conservative treatment for fracture
physiotherapy (magnetic field therapy, ice therapy, active mobilization exercise and cycling exercise)
treatment at 24-hour Ambulatory Clinic of Pok Oi Hospital
seven sessions of physiotherapy between 31 March 2005 and 13 May 2005
